args.message: Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
`src/money.py`'s `round_money` documented banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, causing the nightly build to fail on `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` (e.g. `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`).

## Change
- Switch the rounding mode in `round_money` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` (and update the import).

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` passed on commit `08d3cd5986`.

Note: this changes rounding behavior for exact half-cent amounts, which will now round to the even cent.

trace.final:
I fixed the rounding bug on a new branch, CI passed, and pull request #101 is open against main with alex as reviewer.

**The bug:** In `src/money.py`, `round_money` said it used banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but the code used `ROUND_HALF_UP`. That's why `tests/test_money.py` failed: `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`.

**What I did:**
1. Created the branch `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding` from main.
2. Changed `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`, and updated the import to match (commit `08d3cd5986`).
3. Ran CI on the branch (run `ci-0001`), and it passed.
4. Opened the PR: https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101

**Heads-up:** this changes behavior. Amounts that land exactly on a half-cent will now round to the even cent instead of always rounding up. I noted this in the PR description.

I didn't merge the PR. Merging into main needs a code owner's approval.
